note: One entry per FR3 (roadmap B2). Every entry point that drives an arm names the arm (or its IP) explicitly; nothing falls back to a default arm. robot_ip and corenetic_device_id must equal the arm's replay_config (checked by fr3_arms.validate); corenetic_device_id is null, with no_gripper_why, for an arm whose gripper BOX is not driven (bare flange, or a gripper not wired in yet). payload is the end-effector load Desk should hold for the arm as it is mounted now; null = not declared, and preflight then only reports what Desk holds. start_joints_rad is where move_to_start takes the arm. Left and right are the arms' own: stand behind the bases facing where they face. 10-26: the arm that was 'right' until then (192.168.11.102, the registered one) is the left; the new arm went in to its right.

placement.source: tape 10-30: base centres 0.66 m apart, parallel, no fore-aft offset; carts 5 cm off the table edge, table top 10 cm above them. Not B3: sigma stays the unknown-placement 20 mm until the arm-arm ball edge exists.

right.gripper_note: 11-02: the corenetic gripper is on this arm. Its BOX was 596523097 until the v4.1 firmware (10-31) renumbered every BOX (the handheld 1819152274 is now 3906437858); both report sn box_collection_controller_000001, so tell them apart by device_id.
right.start_source: panda_py constants.JOINT_POSITION_START, as the left arm

payload.source: 11-09 identification on this arm (calibration page, gripper + camera, no SMR; run 20261109_151242, 45 poses, mass std 5.1 g); Desk config outputs/fr3_payload/desk/20261109_152610 on Thor, imported into Desk (the 15:52 run 20261109_155224 reads it back)

right.payload_note: Gripper + camera, no SMR: mounting the SMR or taking the camera off changes it (10-12 on the then-right arm, gripper + SMR: m_ee 1.111 kg, F_x_Cee (16.8, -22.2, 60.9) mm). The Desk TCP in that config (z 190.16 mm) is an estimate, not the socket the replay drives (corenetic_socket_ee, 205.5 mm from the flange face, 11-09 pivot). Out of its transport pose 10-26 (j4 had been past the FR3 limit).

left.no_gripper_why: 11-10: it carries a gripper + camera like the right arm's, but that gripper's BOX is not wired in yet (its id is not known here), so the replay YAML still drives a mock gripper. Its first gripper (BOX 596523097, 3100715645 since the v4.1 firmware) went to the right arm 11-02.
left.start_source: panda_py constants.JOINT_POSITION_START (what Panda.move_to_start() used before B2)

payload.source: the right arm's 11-09 identification (same gripper + camera build, no SMR), imported into this arm's Desk 11-10 (gravity compensation checked by hand); not identified on this arm

left.payload_note: 11-10: the same end effector as the right arm, so the right arm's Desk config (outputs/fr3_payload/desk/20261109_152610 on Thor) went into its Desk too; no check run or identification of its own yet. None of the three pivots (FR3 socket check, handheld same-ball, two-arm same-ball) has been done on it. Its first gripper went for repair 10-23, back on the right arm 11-02. 10-12 Desk held m_ee 1.111 kg, F_x_Cee (16.8, -22.2, 60.9) mm with gripper + SMR (outputs/fr3_payload/20261012_154421_fr3_smr_in.json on Thor). The base was moved 10-26 and is not in its final place: the world -> fr3_base edge on Thor is stale until it is registered again.
